cost_basis: MEASURED ON THIS CASE, not derived from another: 13.09 / 17.48 / 40.34 core-microseconds per cell-step at 3,840 / 30,720 / 245,760 cells on 4 ranks, from scratch arms of 200 / 150 / 24 steps on this box on 2026-08-27 at load average 19.66 on 16 cores, taken as the marginal cost per step by differencing the first and last ExecutionTime and ClockTime readings so startup is excluded, times 4 ranks, divided by the cell count, taking the LARGER of the two readings at each level (ExecutionTime/step 0.01256 / 0.12671 / 2.14435 s; ClockTime/step 0.01005 / 0.13423 / 2.47826 s). The growth is the DIC-PCG pressure iteration count roughly doubling per level (mean 63.7 / 116.0 / 233.8). Cell-steps 2,580,480 / 41,287,680 / 660,602,880 give 0.563 / 12.028 / 444.145 = 456.74 core-min. TWO CAVEATS: the fine arm ran 24 steps from rest during the phase where the pressure field changes fastest, so its iteration count likely OVER-estimates the steady rate and 456.74 is conservative; and the rate was measured UNDER real contention, which is why the pre-spend projector applies NO contention multiplier. Registered CAP 680 core-min (prereg section 8, 1.489x the estimate, 45 % of the 1500 core-min ceiling the dispatch set). Core-minutes are the measured unit; DOLLARS ARE DERIVED, NOT MEASURED, at the owner-stated $0.0513/core-h, reported-by-owner: $0.39 estimate, $0.58 at cap -- the box cannot read its own billing (COMPUTE_BUDGET_CHARTER.md section 5).
